name: SegmentedControl
summary: One choice among two to five views or modes, always one selected: a track of items with a thumb that slides to the selected one.
useWhen: Switching the view of the same content in place: list or grid, day, week or month
Picking a mode or a range that applies at once: monthly or yearly billing, 7 or 30 days on a chart
Two to five short options where exactly one is always on and all fit on one line
avoidWhen: The choice shows different panels of content, each with its own heading
A choice in a form that is saved with the form
More than five options, or options that need long labels
Options that can be on together, or none at all

value.description: The selected value, controlled. Pair with onValueChange.

defaultValue.description: The value selected at first, uncontrolled. Set it: one item is always selected.

onValueChange.description: Called with the new value. Never called with an empty value: a press on the selected item does nothing.

aria-label.description: The control's name, for example Calendar range. Required unless aria-labelledby is set.

aria-labelledby.description: The id of a visible label that names the control. Required unless aria-label is set.

size.description: Height of the whole control: md 32 and lg 44 px from size.control in the default density, sm 28 px, xs 26 px (xs and sm drop the inset so every item keeps its 24px target).

shape.description: pill is fully round (radius.pill), default takes radius.control, square takes radius.sm. The item and thumb corners nest inside the track's.

disabled.description: Every item is disabled (aria-disabled, stays focusable, never selected). Sets data-disabled on the root.

fullWidth.description: Fills the width of its container; the items share it equally. A label that does not fit wraps onto a second line and the item grows in height, so keep labels short. Sets data-full-width.

children.description: Two to five SegmentedControlItems, each with a unique value. An item takes children (the label), start, icon with label for the icon only form, and disabled.

a11y.role: radiogroup of radio items with aria-checked (Radix ToggleGroup type single), named by aria-label or aria-labelledby
a11y.focus: One tab stop: Tab enters on the selected item. Selection follows focus: the arrows, Home and End move focus and select. Disabled items keep aria-disabled and stay focusable and in the arrow order (anatomy rule 5); focus on them does not select.

keys.Tab: Moves focus to the selected item, then out of the control
keys.Shift+Tab: Moves focus out of the control, backward
keys.ArrowRight: Selects the next item in the reading direction (the previous one in RTL); wraps
keys.ArrowLeft: Selects the previous item in the reading direction (the next one in RTL); wraps
keys.Space: Selects the focused item; on the selected item it does nothing
keys.Enter: Selects the focused item; on the selected item it does nothing

a11y.announce: The control name when focus enters, then the item name with checked and its position in the set, for example Week, radio button, checked, 2 of 3.
notes: Selected is not told by color alone: the thumb is a filled shape with a 2px inner ring (as ToggleButton's on ring), and the text is the bright text.
The indicator is aria-hidden: the radio state carries the selection.
In forced colors the thumb hides and the selected item is drawn in Highlight and HighlightText.
Every icon only item needs its own label.

The contract suite checks the arrows, Home and End as focus-moves; that the selection follows focus, and that Space and Enter select, are unit tests (SegmentedControl.test.tsx), since focusing an item already selects it.
Disabled items stay focusable; Shift+Tab from one leaves the control backward.

en.name: Name the control by what it sets: Calendar range, Board view, Billing period. Sentence case.
en.labels: One or two words in sentence case, a noun for the view or mode: Day, Week, Month; List, Grid. Keep the labels about the same length. Digits are Western: 7 days.

ar.name: Noun form, no diacritics: نطاق التقويم، عرض اللوحة.
ar.labels: Short noun form labels, no diacritics: يوم، أسبوع، شهر؛ شهري، سنوي. Western digits.

react.behavior: radix:ToggleGroup type single, the value never empty, selection follows focus; items are ToggleButton roots on ButtonBase
react.note: The indicator is measured from the selected item (logical start, top, inline and block size) and slides with catalog['tab-indicator'], transform only. Reduced motion plays nothing: it jumps. A ResizeObserver re-places it, without motion, when density, fonts or labels change the size.

angular.behavior: [dsSegmentedControl] host with roving focus; items are dsToggleButton with data-part item; the indicator placed by the same measuring and the motion catalog
angular.note: SegmentedControl.css and Button.css are used as is.

native.behavior: rn-primitives:toggle-group type single, the thumb moved with Reanimated from the tab-indicator native numbers

styles.studio: An overlay track with a hairline; the thumb is the overlay-20 fill; a pill by default.
styles.desk: The same pill track and thumb in Desk's overlay and border colors.
styles.neutral: Takes the tokens of the Neutral style, no recipe.

mistakes.wrong: A SegmentedControl that switches between panels of content
mistakes.right: Tabs, which names and links each panel

mistakes.wrong: A SegmentedControl with no selected item
mistakes.right: Set defaultValue or value: one item is always selected

mistakes.wrong: Seven options squeezed into one control
mistakes.right: At most five; use Select for more

mistakes.wrong: A SegmentedControl inside a form that is saved with a submit button
Animating the thumb with left or width
mistakes.right: The tab-indicator pattern, transform only, that jumps under reduced motion
